title: Ritual Pouch
summary: Helsik’s pouch contains the five components for the House of Hope ritual.

fields.Contents: Skull, Incense, Diamond, Infernal Marble and Coin of Mammon.
fields.Quest use: Use the five components in the upstairs ritual circle at the Devil’s Fee. Helsik provides the pouch when she makes a deal. It can also be pickpocketed or looted.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources.
